sentence: MedlinePlus (a US source) says dutasteride is used to treat benign prostatic hyperplasia, an enlarged prostate gland, and belongs to the 5-alpha reductase inhibitors.
note: MedlinePlus: dutasteride used for benign prostatic hyperplasia (enlarged prostate); belongs to 5-alpha reductase inhibitors. [second-pass edit]

sentence: The NHS says finasteride for hair loss is available only on a private prescription, not on the NHS.
note: NHS About finasteride: for hair loss only on private prescription, not on the NHS; still licensed on NHS for enlarged prostate.

sentence: Reviews describe dutasteride as blocking both type 1 and type 2 of the 5-alpha reductase enzyme, whereas finasteride mainly blocks type 2, and dutasteride lowers blood DHT further than finasteride does.
note: StatPearls dutasteride page describes inhibition of types I and II only; the 'all 3 isoenzymes / 99%' wording appears on the finasteride StatPearls page and conflicts with other reviews. Dutasteride lowering serum DHT more than finasteride is supported by PMC1550785 (dual inhibitor, near-complete suppression) and PMC2809314 (head-to-head: about 94.7% vs 70.8%); PMC10080355 says finasteride is type 2 selective. [second-pass edit]

sentence: A systematic review found insufficient evidence that either finasteride or dutasteride has an advantage over the other in efficacy or safety for clinically important outcomes.
note: PMC5407420 systematic review: insufficient evidence that either finasteride or dutasteride offers an advantage in efficacy or safety for clinically important outcomes.

sentence: StatPearls lists erection problems, reduced sex drive and difficulty ejaculating among the sexual side effects of dutasteride, and advises that breast enlargement or tenderness be reported.
note: Retrieved MedlinePlus text did not show the side-effect list (erection, sex drive, ejaculation, breast changes). StatPearls dutasteride gives impotence, decreased libido, difficulty ejaculating and advises reporting breast enlargement or tenderness. [second-pass edit]

sentence: StatPearls notes that sexual side effects may persist after dutasteride is stopped.
note: StatPearls dutasteride: sexual adverse effects may persist despite discontinuation (another StatPearls page calls this rare).

sentence: The NHS says most men aged 18 or over can take finasteride, but it is generally not recommended for women or children.
note: NHS Who can and cannot take finasteride: most men 18 or over can take it; generally not recommended for women or children.

sentence: The NHS lists depression or thoughts of self-harm, severe bladder problems and liver problems among the things to mention to the doctor before starting finasteride.
note: NHS page lists depression or thoughts of harming themselves, severe bladder problems and liver problems among things to tell a doctor.

sentence: The NHS says it is very unlikely that a partner taking finasteride will harm a woman or her baby.
note: NHS Fertility and pregnancy page: harm to a pregnant partner or baby from a man taking finasteride is very unlikely.

sentence: MedlinePlus (a US source) says dutasteride is for use only in men, and that women who are or may become pregnant should not handle dutasteride capsules.
note: MedlinePlus excerpt confirms women who are or may become pregnant should not handle capsules, but blood-donation advice was not found on MedlinePlus (only in a trial consent form, six months after stopping). Blood-donation clause removed. [second-pass edit]

sentence: The NHS says anyone with thoughts of harming themselves should call 999 or go to A&E; for low mood or distress, NHS 111 (mental health option) and Samaritans on 116 123, free at any time, can help.
note: NHS side-effects page: call 999 or go to A&E if thoughts of harming yourself; About page: mood changes such as depression/self-harm thoughts, speak to doctor. NHS 111 and Samaritans not in retrieved NHS finasteride text; they are the site's generic routes. Original wording (call 111 for self-harm thoughts) did not match NHS wording, so reworded. [second-pass edit]
